live_feed_hosts.definition: live fragrance rows whose mechanism is one of woo_store_json, shopify, salla_api, magento_graphql, algolia, Bahrain tier first then country BH, then priority_rank

live_hosts_with_no_mechanism.definition: live fragrance rows with mechanism '' (served by the generic page-scrape path; genuine_method recorded)

live_rows_country_currency_mismatch.definition: live fragrance rows whose currency is not the national currency of their country (BH BHD, UAE AED, KSA SAR, QA QAR, OM OMR, KW KWD) or whose tier 'bahrain' disagrees with country != BH

caveats: the catalog rows load only when ENABLE_BH_GCC_CATALOG_SOURCES is on (source_router._load_catalog_rows); its production state is not read here (CLAUDE.md records it ON since 2026-06-26, not a session-81 ledger line)
a catalog row whose apex a literal row covers is skipped at load (shadowed_by_literal_row)
status 'live' is the registry's own recorded liveness (scripts/verify_bh_gcc_sources.py), not re-measured; zero network here
the search descriptor is read at runtime only behind ENABLE_SEARCH_DESCRIPTOR
